title: Multidegree modulo an invertible integer on a proper reduced curve
statement:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field and let $D$ be a reduced proper $k$-scheme, separated and of finite type, all of whose irreducible components have dimension one; the empty scheme is allowed [def-sc-curves], [def-pc-reduced-scheme], [def-weil-irreducible-components]. Let $I$ be its finite set of irreducible components, each given its reduced induced scheme structure, and let $N\geq1$ be invertible in $k$. For a line bundle $L$ on $D$, put $\deg_i(L)=\chi(D_i,L|_{D_i})-\chi(D_i,\mathcal O_{D_i})$ [def-pc-degree-line-bundle], with $\chi$ the Euler characteristic [def-pc-euler-characteristic]. Then the homomorphism on the Picard group [def-sc-picard-group]
$$\operatorname{Pic}(D)/N\operatorname{Pic}(D)\longrightarrow\bigoplus_{i\in I}\mathbf Z/N\mathbf Z,\qquad [L]\longmapsto(\deg_i(L)\bmod N)_i$$
is an isomorphism.

source.place: IX Corollary 4.7 and degree-component quotient (4.8), printed pp. 35–36; used in XVIII 1.1.3.2. No Stacks tag located for this precise multidegree quotient.
